notes: The student profile draws its figures as counters that count up from 0, inside a closed accordion, with each figure in a data-target attribute of the page source, which the source check reads (INC-0158). Read on September 27, 2026, it gives an average undergraduate GPA of 3.47, 1.81 average years of work experience, a middle 50 percent GMAT of 515 to 585 with no edition named, a middle 50 percent GRE of 300 to 310 and 83 percent receiving tuition assistance, and its visible heading names no cohort. It earlier gave 3.49, 2.73 years and 19 percent international, with an average GMAT of 576 and an average GRE of 306, recorded then as the Fall 2025 cohort. No GMAT is recorded because the page names no edition, and the GRE is published only as a combined range. Class size, percent women, acceptance rate, salary, and employment rate are not published. Tuition is published only as total program tuition and fees at 2026-27 rates: resident 30256 USD, non-resident 66220 USD, with tuition not itemized separately from fees (https://harbert.auburn.edu/degrees-programs/mba/full-time-mba/tuition-financial-assistance.html); no annual tuition-only figure.
